title: Apartment Home Lease Payment Plans — Arrears Size Loading
content:
The plan percentage of an Apartment Home Lease payment plan rises with the size of the plan arrears against the current month's base rent line: plan arrears above one month's rent add 0.05, plan arrears above half a month's rent add 0.02, and smaller plan arrears add nothing.

## Questions answered

**What is "one month's rent" here?** The current month's base rent line — the base rent line of the latest billing period carrying one — as posted.

**Which arrears are compared?** The plan arrears of the plan being signed, as they stand on the day of signing.

**How is the loading used?** It is added to the plan percentage before the percentage is applied.

## Loading table

| Plan arrears compared with the current month's base rent line | Loading added |
|---|---|
| above the whole line | 0.05 |
| above half the line, up to and including the whole line | 0.02 |
| half the line or less | nothing |

## Boundaries (hypothetical base rent line $2,000.00)

| Plan arrears | Loading |
|---|---|
| $2,000.01 | 0.05 |
| $2,000.00 | 0.02 |
| $1,000.01 | 0.02 |
| $1,000.00 | nothing |
